svg.text: Block diagram — telemetry- and voice-driven feedback visualizer
Solid = forward signal path. Dashed orange = closed loop. Bracketed codes are the operation numbers in the signals table.
directory structure -> attractor cloud (not a time series)
L1 frame spectrum -> AGC + warp check [ops 18-20]
L2 task execution -> real machine load -> telemetry (signal IS the work)
L4 human: sees display -> speaks / slides -> new task [ops 7, 9]
V = 44.1 kHz audio-rate path, the only Nyquist-comfortable signal in the system. T = 0.3-5 Hz control-rate path, usable band 0-2.5 Hz without root.
Objective 1 = columns A-B-D-E. Objective 2 adds the voice path (A.MIC -> B.V -> C.ASR) and the morphogenesis layout in D.
